description: Super Agent layer for Hermes, distributed as a core patchset with a file-copy payload (NOT a plugin): trigger intake, admission gate, orchestrator, outbox delivery, attention panel, plus the 2026-11-04 update trains (punch-list tick drain and blocked-card auto-resume; surfaces wake-chain and local-turn intake; gates enforced script gates, deterministic model assignment, and coded escalation). Ships with its own features disabled; observe-first. The three kanban sub-features (gates, assignment, escalation) each default OFF in config and are read only through hermes_cli.kanban_board_config. Installing changes some stock behaviors even while disabled - see README-PACKAGE.md.
manifest_note: Provenance/inventory note only - NOT a Hermes plugin manifest and not read by the installer. Hermes's own manifest format (plugins/<name>/dashboard/manifest.json) covers dashboard plugins. This package is a core patchset with a file-copy payload: it is not a dashboard plugin, not a directory plugin (no register(ctx) discovery), and not catalog-listable as a plugin. This file maps each payload module to the path it is installed at inside a Hermes checkout, lists the core patches in apply order, and records the version of record. install.sh copies the payload/ tree wholesale (this file excluded) and does not consult this manifest; remove.sh rebuilds the payload list from the tree.

modules.description: Orchestrator runtime and persistence (trigger ingress, sa_triggers, policy snapshots, tick eval drain).
Orchestrator read operations and derived ticket-stage projections.
Inbound input delivery and worker-run wake coordination.
Pure admission gate (policy-based trigger admission, no I/O).
GitHub Source poller (issues, PRs, comments, CI).
Health triggers for dispatcher/worker anomalies.
Durable outbound reply queue and delivery state machine.
Pause state persistence and trigger deadline shifting.
PR following and follows-done rule (comment/run-report hooks).
Thread-ticket subscription storage operations.
VibeHard Source poller (ledger jobs and status transitions).
Deterministic model assignment: work_class classification and seat resolution at card creation time.
Board-owned kanban config loader and validator (gates/assignment/escalation sections, each default OFF).
Coded escalation: gate-exhaustion and refused-run triggers, seat swap, spend ceilings.
Enforced script gates: gate_spec validation, workspace fingerprinting, check execution, verdict filing.
Local (desktop/TUI) turn recording for Super Agent trigger candidacy; armed only when enabled and 'local' is a pilot surface.
Router (orchestrator_*) toolset handlers and gating.
JSON schemas for the router toolset.
Attention panel page (reachable only via the 07-panel-frontend seam's route).
Router prompt asset: Super Agent front-door instructions installed into the Router profile's system prompt.

name: hermes-superagent
